project(appcompat)

include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/appcompat/apphelp)

spec2def(acppage.dll acppage.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# acppage.dll is all Rust (acppage-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/acppage-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ACPPage.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/acppage-rust/src/acppage/ACPPage_cpp_h.rs)
# CEditCompatModes.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/acppage-rust/src/acppage/CEditCompatModes_cpp_h.rs)
# CLayerUIPropPage.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/acppage-rust/src/acppage/CLayerUIPropPage_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(acppage_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_link_libraries(acppage_shims PRIVATE wine uuid cpprt atl_classes libshell32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(acppage_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(acppage acppage-cargo acppage.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE acppage-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS acppage_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
